newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket up $0.30 to $22.50.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket up $0.30 to $22.50.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and oil products rose $0.30 to $22.50 per barrel in the week to Friday, one of its highest levels in recent months, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
The increase reflected higher demand due to the cold snap still affecting most parts of Europe and also North America.
Mines and Energy Minister Erwin Arrieta said these climactic factors accounted for an increase in demand of two to three percent compared with the same period last year.
Venezuela's average oil export price for 1996 was $18.25 per barrel, sharply up from $14.84 in 1995 and $13.23 in 1994.
The government has based 1997 budget calculations on an average price of $14.00 per barrel.
Arrieta told reporters that such "unstable" oil prices made it difficult to forecast budget revenue. "We want the prices to stabilize, structurally speaking," he said.
